search_window.basis: From latest verified prior Food Line heartbeat completion at 20:42:56.032 PST on 2026-11-02; discovery queries used 2-day recency for indexing lag. Only new qualifying access disruptions in this observation interval count.

coverage_notes.purpose: Bounded supplementary recall only; primary national Food Line production collector remains authoritative.
target_classes: Closure/fire/disaster/loss of only, sole, last, or full-service community grocery
Canceled or suspended emergency food distribution due to storm/flood/fire/outage/facility damage
Abrupt food pantry or food bank closure or major access reduction
Official SNAP/WIC/food assistance interruption with immediate access consequences
bounded_query_context: "sole grocery store" closes fire town November 2026
"food bank" distribution cancelled flooding outage November 2 2026
"food pantry" closed due to fire November 2 2026
"food bank" temporarily closed storm power outage November 2026
coverage_notes.observation: All 12 targeted searches produced usable coverage. No newly verified qualifying U.S. food-access interruption reported after the prior heartbeat was identified. Returned items were mainly older single-store closures, historical disaster cases, routine pantry fundraising, prior-year SNAP notices, and older food-bank problems without new hour-specific developments.

excluded_examples.reason: Material Provo food bank temporary closure was announced before this hour and planned for November 1; article indexed as about two days old. No independently verified new development in the search window.
Exploratory facility lease for Floyd County pantry, not verified closure or immediate access cut.
Earlier storm recovery information lists an operating emergency food distribution, not a newly canceled distribution.
SNAP stoppage refers to the 2025 federal shutdown, not a 2026 interruption.
Historical Canadian grocery fire outside U.S. remit.

duplicate_screen.method: Read branch ledger listing and preceding three heartbeats; checked publication/event dates, immediacy of food-access consequence, and duplication.

coverage_notes.limitations: Search-engine discovery and indexing can miss same-hour primary-source notices. Twelve searches found no *verified* new eligible item; this does not establish complete national absence.
coverage_notes.production_authority: No approval, publishing, primary pipeline modification, schedule change, or disable action.
